title: Prime Minister expresses grief over loss of lives in mishap in Anand, Gujarat
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has expressed deep sorrow over the loss of lives in a mishap in Anand, Gujarat.
The Prime Minister conveyed his condolences to the bereaved families and prayed for the speedy recovery of all those injured.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X;
“Deeply saddened by the loss of lives in a mishap in Anand, Gujarat. Condolences to the bereaved families. I pray for the speedy recovery of all those injured: PM @narendramodi”
